scenarios.fact: Exact production-shaped dataset and personas exist.
Owner, team member, and outsider receive their distinct allowed views and writes.
Indexed status, assignee, project, and label filters return deterministic results.
Stable 50-row cursor pagination remains nonduplicating under concurrent insert.
Issue detail composes project, assignee, labels, comments, and activity.
Status, priority, assignee, and board position reconcile authoritatively.
Concurrent board moves/edits produce a documented deterministic outcome.
Comments and activity reach a second client through attributed native realtime.
Full-text issue search uses the provider's ordinary supported path or is GAP.
Retained views and one queued edit are reconciled where supported, otherwise GAP.
An indexed field is added without losing the seeded data.
Hosted deployment identity, logs, configuration, and rollback/export path are inspectable.
Frozen list/detail/write/realtime/deploy samples and the disclosed fresh-target or shared-target cost window are retained.
Only exact fresh targets or the arm-owned shared-target namespace are cleaned up; unrelated baseline state is preserved.
